Event Date
Date of Notification of Examination 16.09.2026
Last Date for Filling up of Online Application 06.10.2026
Date of Preliminary (Stage-I) Examination 31.01.2027
Date of Main (Stage-II) Examination 18.06.2027
Personality Test/Interview (Stage-III) Not specified in the notification; will be intimated to candidates who qualify Stage-II

UPSC ESE 2027 Vacancy Details

The number of vacancies to be filled on the basis of the results of ESE 2027 is expected to be approximately 480, including 19 vacancies reserved for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) - 11 for Locomotor Disability, and the remainder distributed across Hard of Hearing, Low Vision, and Specific Learning Disability & Multiple Disabilities categories, as detailed below. The number of vacancies is liable to alteration.

PwBD Category Vacancies
Locomotor Disability (LD) 11
Hard of Hearing (HH) Included within the 19 total (exact split by category in the official notice)
Low Vision (LV) 1
Specific Learning Disability & Multiple Disabilities (SLD & MD) 1
Total PwBD Vacancies 19

Recruitment is made to Group 'A' and Group 'B' engineering services/posts under various Ministries and Departments of the Government of India, including but not limited to Central Engineering Service, Central Engineering Service (Roads), Indian Railway Management Service (Civil/Mechanical/Electrical/Signal & Telecommunication/Stores), Central Water Engineering Service, Indian Telecommunication Service, Indian Radio Regulatory Service, Indian Naval Armament Service, Indian Naval Material Management Service, Indian Defence Service of Engineers, Central Power Engineering Service, Indian Skill Development Service, and Assistant Executive Engineer (Geological Survey of India), among others, as detailed in Annexure-I of the ESE 2027 Rules.

UPSC ESE 2027 Eligibility Criteria

Nationality

A candidate must be either a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal, a subject of Bhutan, a Tibetan refugee who came to India before 01.01.1962 with the intention of permanently settling in India, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated from Pakistan, Burma, Sri Lanka, or specified East African countries or Vietnam with the intention of permanently settling in India (subject to a certificate of eligibility from the Government of India for the latter categories).

Educational Qualification

For admission to the examination, a candidate must have:

  • Obtained a degree in Engineering from a University incorporated by an Act of the Central or State Legislature in India, or another educational institution established by an Act of Parliament or deemed a University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956; OR
  • Passed Sections A and B of the Institution Examinations of the Institution of Engineers (India); OR
  • Obtained a degree/diploma in Engineering from a recognised foreign University/College/Institution; OR
  • Passed the Graduate Membership Examination of the Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (India); OR
  • Passed the Associate Membership Examination Parts II and III/Sections A and B of the Aeronautical Society of India; OR
  • Passed the Graduate Membership Examination of the Institution of Electronics and Radio Engineers, London (held after November 1959).

For the posts of Indian Naval Armament Service (Electronics Engineering) and Indian Radio Regulatory Service Group 'A', an M.Sc. degree or equivalent with Wireless Communication Electronics, Radio Physics, or Radio Engineering as a special subject is also accepted, as specified in the notification.

Important note: Following a Delhi High Court judgment dated 13.01.2023, degrees/certificates from the Institution of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineers (India) and the Aeronautical Society of India obtained after admission post 31.05.2013 will NOT be admissible for ESE 2027. Eligibility of candidates with a degree/certificate from the Institution of Engineers (India), admitted after 31.05.2013, is subject to a pending Government decision following a separate Delhi High Court judgment.

Candidates who have appeared for, or intend to appear for, the qualifying examination may also apply; such admission is provisional. Candidates without the prescribed qualification at the time of application must upload proof of passing within 10 days of the Main Examination result being declared, failing which they will not be permitted to appear for the Personality Test/Interview.

Medical Examination & Physical Standards

Candidates finally recommended by the Commission are required to undergo a medical examination as decided by the Department of Telecommunications, Ministry of Communications; the findings of the Medical Board are final and binding for allotment purposes. Candidates must also meet the physical standards prescribed in Appendix-II of the ESE 2027 Rules, published in the Gazette of India (Extraordinary) dated 16.09.2026.

UPSC ESE 2027 Age Limit

A candidate must have attained the age of 21 years and must not have attained the age of 30 years on 01.01.2027 - i.e., born not earlier than 02.01.1997 and not later than 01.01.2006.

Category Age Relaxation
SC / ST Up to 5 years
OBC (eligible for reservation) Up to 3 years
Defence Services personnel disabled in operations/hostilities Up to 3 years
Ex-Servicemen (incl. Commissioned Officers, ECOs/SSCOs with ≥5 years' service) Up to 5 years
ECOs/SSCOs who completed initial 5-year assignment, extended and certified releasable Up to 5 years
PwBD (Low Vision, Deaf & Hard of Hearing, Locomotor Disability incl. Leprosy Cured/Dwarfism/Acid Attack Victims/Muscular Dystrophy, Specific Learning Disability, Mental Illness) Up to 10 years
Eligible Government servants in specified departments (holding permanent posts, or ≥3 years' continuous temporary service) Up to 35 years (i.e., up to 5 years' relaxation)

Candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC who also fall under Ex-Servicemen or PwBD categories are eligible for cumulative relaxation under both categories. Once a candidate selects General/Reserved category at the time of application, subsequent requests to change category will not be entertained by the Commission.

UPSC ESE 2027 Application Fee

Candidates (except Female/SC/ST/PwBD, who are exempted from fee payment) are required to pay a fee of ₹200 (Rupees Two Hundred only), payable through net banking of any bank, or by Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card/UPI. Payment through any other mode is not valid or acceptable, and applications submitted without the prescribed fee (unless fee remission is claimed) will be summarily rejected. Fee once paid will not be refunded under any circumstances, nor can it be adjusted against any other examination. No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS candidates - they must pay the fee in full.

UPSC ESE 2027 Exam Pattern

ESE 2027 is conducted in three stages: Stage-I (Preliminary Examination, objective type), Stage-II (Main Examination, conventional type), and Stage-III (Personality Test/Interview).

Stage-I: Preliminary Examination (Objective Type)

Paper Subject Duration Maximum Marks
Paper-I General Studies and Engineering Aptitude 2 hours 200
Paper-II Engineering Discipline-specific (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, as opted) 3 hours 300
Total 500 marks

Only candidates who qualify the Preliminary/Stage-I Examination are eligible for admission to the Main/Stage-II Examination. Marks obtained in Stage-I by qualified candidates count towards the final order of merit. Approximately 6 to 7 times the number of vacancies are admitted to the Main Examination.

Stage-II: Main Examination (Conventional Type)

Paper Subject Duration Maximum Marks
Paper-I Engineering Discipline-specific (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering, as opted) 3 hours 300
Paper-II Engineering Discipline-specific (same discipline as Paper-I) 3 hours 300
Total 600 marks

Conventional papers must be answered in English; question papers are set in English only.

Stage-III: Personality Test/Interview

Carries 200 marks, with no minimum qualifying marks. Candidates summoned are about twice the number of vacancies to be filled. Special attention is paid to assessing the candidate's capacity for leadership, initiative, intellectual curiosity, tact and other social qualities, mental and physical energy, powers of practical application, and integrity of character.

Negative Marking

  • In objective-type papers, there are 4 alternatives for each question; for each wrong answer, 1/3rd of the marks assigned to that question is deducted as a penalty.
  • If a candidate gives more than one answer to a question, it is treated as wrong, with the same penalty, even if one of the answers happens to be correct.
  • Questions left unanswered carry no penalty.

Final ranking is determined by the sum of marks obtained in Stage-I (Preliminary), Stage-II (Main), and Stage-III (Personality Test/Interview). Candidates are allotted to various services based on their rank and preferences expressed for services/posts.

How to Apply for UPSC ESE 2027

  1. Visit the UPSC Online Application Portal, https://upsconline.nic.in.
  2. Complete Account Creation, Universal Registration (to generate a Universal Registration Number, URN - needed only once in a lifetime), and the Common Application Form (CAF) - these are common to all UPSC examinations and can be filled anytime.
  3. Fill the fourth, examination-specific module (including fee and exam centre selection) during the notified application window for ESE 2027.
  4. Upload your photograph and also capture a live photograph as prompted while filling the CAF.
  5. Sign three times (one below the other) on plain white paper using black ink, and upload the scanned signature.
  6. Upload the required scanned documents: Proof of Date of Birth (Matriculation/10th certificate), Certificate of Educational Qualification, and Certificate in support of age/fee concession claims (wherever applicable).
  7. Pay the applicable fee online (if not exempted) via net banking or Visa/Master/RuPay Credit/Debit Card/UPI.
  8. Review all details carefully - no correction/alteration is allowed after submission, except through the specific one-time URN edit facility described in the notification.
  9. Submit the application before the closing date, 06.10.2026.

Applicants are strongly advised to use their Aadhaar Card as the ID document for smoother verification and authentication.

UPSC ESE 2027 Important Instructions

  • Candidates must ensure they fulfil all eligibility conditions for admission to the examination; admission at all stages is purely provisional, subject to satisfying the prescribed eligibility criteria. Issue of an e-Admit Card does not imply final clearance of candidature - the Commission verifies eligibility with reference to original documents only after a candidate qualifies for the Personality Test/Interview.
  • All communication regarding the examination will be through the registered email ID and the Commission's website - candidates must furnish a correct, active email address and mobile number.
  • Candidates should retain their Application Number, Roll Number (once received), and other registration details for all future correspondence with the Commission.
  • If any irrelevant matter, signage, or marks that could disclose a candidate's identity are found on the answer script, the Commission will impose a penalty of deduction of marks, or may not evaluate that script.
  • Candidates should read the detailed Rules of ESE 2027 (notified by the Ministry of Communications, Department of Telecommunications) and the full Examination Notice carefully before applying, including the Functional Classification and Physical Requirements for PwBD categories set out in Annexure-I of the Rules.
  • The Commission does not enter into correspondence with candidates regarding reasons for non-selection or non-shortlisting.
  • Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification of the candidate.

The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has invited online recruitment applications under Advertisement No. 11/2026 for recruitment by selection to seven posts spread across different Central Government Ministries, Departments and Union Territory administrations. The posts include Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy and General Medicine), Assistant Editor, Specialist Grade-II (Junior Scale) in Anaesthesiology and Paediatrics, Assistant Public Prosecutor, and Public Law Officer/District Litigation Officer/Law Officer for the UT of Ladakh.

In brief: UPSC is recruiting for 7 distinct posts under Advt No. 11/2026, with a combined total of 212 vacancies. Vacancies range from single-post NDMC specialist roles to 140 posts of Assistant Public Prosecutor in Delhi. Applications are online only via https://upsconline.nic.in, open from 12.09.2026. The closing date is 02.10.2026 (1800 hrs) for all posts except the Ladakh post, which closes 09.10.2026. Selection is by interview (with possible shortlisting/Recruitment Test where the Commission deems necessary).

Vacancy numbers, reservation positions, and PwBD suitability/reservation are as notified against each post.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Eligibility Criteria (Post-wise)

1. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (Anatomy)

  • Age: 40 years for UR/EWS; 45 years for SC.
  • Qualification: Post-Graduate degree in Anatomy (e.g., MS/MD/DNB Anatomy, or MBBS with MSc Anatomy, or MSc Medical Anatomy with PhD/DSc) from a recognised teaching institute.
  • Experience: At least 3 years' teaching experience as Senior Resident/Tutor/Demonstrator/Registrar/Assistant Professor/Lecturer in the specialty after the first PG degree.
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: Delhi (liable to serve anywhere in India).

2. Specialist Grade III Assistant Professor (General Medicine)

  • Age: 40 years for UR/EWS; 43 years for OBC; 45 years for SC/ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Recognised MBBS degree plus Postgraduate degree in Medicine/General Medicine (MD/DNB) from a recognised teaching institute.
  • Experience: At least 3 years' teaching experience as Senior Resident/Tutor/Demonstrator/Registrar/Assistant Professor/Lecturer in the specialty after the first PG degree. (Note: experience as General Duty Medical Officer/Medical Officer is not counted.)
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: Delhi (liable to serve anywhere in India).

3. Assistant Editor (Indian Bureau of Mines)

  • Age: 30 years for UR; 35 years for SC; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Journalism/Mass Communication, OR Bachelor's degree with Economics/Statistics/English plus a 1-year diploma in Journalism/Mass Communication.
  • Experience: 3 years' experience editing and publishing in a publishing house, newspaper, news agency, publicity organisation, or government organisation.
  • Desirable: Master's degree in Mass Communication/Journalism/Economics/Statistics/English; experience with publishing software (PageMaker, MS Office, CorelDraw, QuarkXPress, Photoshop).
  • Pay Scale: Level-07 (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: Nagpur, Maharashtra (service liability anywhere in India).

4. Specialist Grade II (Junior Scale) – Anaesthesiology (NDMC)

  • Age: 50 years for ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Recognised medical qualification (MBBS-equivalent) plus PG degree/diploma in Anaesthesiology (MD/MS Anaesthesiology, DA, FFARCS, or equivalent).
  • Experience: 3 years' experience after PG degree, or 5 years' after PG diploma.
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: New Delhi Municipal Council.

5. Specialist Grade-II (Junior Scale) – Paediatrics (NDMC)

  • Age: 45 years for EWS; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Recognised medical qualification plus PG degree/diploma in Paediatrics (MD Paediatrics, or Diploma Paed./DCH).
  • Experience: 3 years' experience after PG degree, or 5 years' after PG diploma.
  • Pay Scale: Level-11 plus NPA (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: New Delhi Municipal Council.

6. Assistant Public Prosecutor (Govt. of NCT of Delhi)

  • Age: 35 years for UR/EWS; 38 years for OBC; 40 years for SC/ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD. Contractual employees get a one-time relaxation up to 5 years (subject to conditions).
  • Qualification: Degree in Law from a recognised University/Institute.
  • Experience: 3 years' experience at the bar.
  • Desirable: Experience as a government advocate.
  • Pay Scale: Level-10 (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: National Capital Territory of Delhi.
  • Mandatory induction training of at least 2 weeks for direct recruits.

7. Public Law Officer/District Litigation Officer/Law Officer (UT of Ladakh)

  • Age: 40 years for ST; further relaxable up to 10 years for PwBD.
  • Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Law (Professional or Integrated) from a university established by law in India, with 2 years' actual practice at the bar, certified by the Principal District & Sessions Judge or Registrar General of the concerned High Court/Supreme Court.
  • Pay Scale: Level-8 (7th CPC).
  • Headquarters: UT of Ladakh.
  • Domicile requirement: Recruitment is exclusive to Domiciles of the UT of Ladakh under the Ladakh Civil Services Decentralization and Recruitment – Grant of Domicile Certificate (Procedure) Rules, 2025. A valid Domicile Certificate issued by the Tehsildar is mandatory.
  • Reservation governed by the Jammu & Kashmir Reservation Act, 2004 (as extended/amended for Ladakh), covering ST, SC, Residents of Areas Adjoining the Actual Line of Control (ALC), EWS, and PwBD.

For all posts, the qualifications shown are relaxable at UPSC's discretion for otherwise well-qualified candidates, and experience requirements may be relaxed for SC/ST candidates if sufficient qualified candidates from these communities are not available.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Application Fee

  • Fee payable: ₹25 (Rupees Twenty-Five only), via Visa/MasterCard/RuPay Credit/Debit Card/UPI or internet banking.
  • Women candidates, and candidates belonging to SC, ST or Persons with Benchmark Disability (PwBD) of any community, are exempted from fee payment.
  • No fee exemption is available to OBC/EWS/Unreserved male candidates - they must pay the full fee.
  • Applications without the prescribed fee will be summarily rejected, with no representation entertained.
  • Fee once paid is non-refundable and cannot be adjusted against any other examination/selection.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Age Relaxation & Concessions

  • SC/ST candidates: 5 years' relaxation; OBC candidates: 3 years' relaxation (for posts reserved for them).
  • PwBD candidates: 10 years' relaxation (cumulative with SC/ST/OBC relaxation where applicable), subject to maximum age on closing date not exceeding 56 years.
  • Ex-Servicemen and Commissioned Officers (incl. ECOs/SSCOs): 5 years' relaxation, subject to minimum 6 months' continuous service after attestation as on closing date.
  • Central/UT Government servants: up to 5 years' relaxation (10 years for SC/ST, 8 years for OBC in posts reserved for them), subject to 3 years' continuous service in an allied cadre.
  • Scribe facility is available for specified categories of PwBD candidates in Recruitment Tests, subject to conditions.

To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Selection Process

  • Recruitment is "by Selection" - primarily interview-based. Mere possession of the essential qualification does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.
  • Where the number of applications is large, UPSC may apply shortlisting criteria: Desirable Qualifications, higher educational qualification, higher/relevant experience, or by holding a Recruitment Test (RT).
  • Minimum level of suitability in interview (out of 100 marks): UR – 50 marks, OBC – 45 marks, SC/ST/PH – 40 marks.
  • Where a Recruitment Test (RT) precedes the interview, candidates must clear the minimum suitability level at both the RT and interview stages.
  • Recruitment Test/Combined Recruitment Test (if held) will ordinarily be conducted at: Ahmedabad, Bhopal, Chennai, Delhi, Dispur (Guwahati), Jaipur, Jammu, Kochi, Kolkata, Lucknow, Mumbai, Nagpur, Port Blair, Ranchi, and Visakhapatnam (for the Ladakh post: Leh, Kargil, Srinagar, and Delhi).
  • Shortlisted candidates must send self-attested copies of documents/certificates as and when demanded by the Commission.
  • Summoning for interview does not guarantee selection. Appointment orders are issued by the Government after final selection.
  • UPSC may grant higher initial pay to candidates adjudged meritorious in the interview.

How to Apply for UPSC Advt No. 11/2026

  1. Visit https://upsconline.nic.in and complete Account Creation, Universal Registration (to generate a Universal Registration Number, URN), and the Common Application Form (CAF) - these three modules are common to all UPSC recruitments and can be filled anytime.

  3. Capture a live photograph as prompted while filling the CAF (in addition to uploading a photograph), ensuring it meets the Commission's photo/signature guidelines.
  4. Sign three times (one below the other) on plain white paper in black ink and upload the scanned signature.
  5. Upload supporting documents for each claim (date of birth, caste, educational qualification, experience, disability, desirable qualification, age relaxation, etc.) separately, in PDF format, in the prescribed proforma where applicable.
  6. Use Aadhaar as your ID document where possible for smoother verification; alternatively use Voter Card/PAN/Passport/Driving Licence.
  7. Review all details carefully - applications cannot be withdrawn, and no correction/alteration/modification is allowed after submission.
  8. Submit the application before the closing date: 02.10.2026 (1800 hrs) for all posts except the Ladakh post, or 09.10.2026 for the Ladakh post.
  9. Take a printout of the finally submitted application for your records - do not send it to UPSC by post; bring it only if called for interview, along with original documents.

UPSC Advt No. 11/2026 Important Instructions

  • A candidate must be a citizen of India, or a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a Tibetan refugee (pre-1962), or a person of Indian origin migrated from specified countries with intent to permanently settle in India - subject to eligibility certificate requirements for the latter categories.
  • The date for determining eligibility in every respect is the closing date for submission of the online application.
  • All correspondence from the Commission will be through the registered email ID only - candidates must furnish a correct, active email address.

  • Mobile phones, pagers, programmable devices, smart watches, cameras, or Bluetooth devices are strictly banned in the examination/interview hall.
  • Face authentication is mandatory for all candidates at the examination venue/interview hall.
  • Canvassing in any form will disqualify a candidate.
  • Government strives for a gender-balanced workforce; women candidates are encouraged to apply.

SSC SI CAPF Recruitment 2026 Selection Process / Scheme of Examination

The examination consists of four mandatory stages: Paper-I, Physical Standard Test (PST) / Physical Endurance Test (PET), Paper-II, and Detailed Medical Examination (DME).

Paper-I

Part Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration

Part Subject No. of Questions Maximum Marks Duration
I General Intelligence and Reasoning 20 40 1 Hour (sectional timer of 20 minutes per part)

Questions in both papers are Objective Multiple Choice Type, set in Hindi and English (Parts I–III). Negative marking: 0.25 marks per wrong answer in Paper-I, 0.50 marks per wrong answer in Paper-II. Difficulty level of Paper-II is higher than Paper-I. NCC Certificate holders get bonus marks: 5% (NCC 'C'), 3% (NCC 'B'), 2% (NCC 'A') of maximum marks in each paper, as on the closing date of application.

Physical Standard Test (PST) – Height & Chest Norms

Height and chest requirements vary by post (SI Delhi Police / SI CAPFs / SI Fire CISF) and candidate category (general, hill areas, Scheduled Tribes, Gorkha, North-Eastern States, etc.), ranging from 154 cm to 170 cm for height depending on category and gender. Female candidates have no minimum chest measurement requirement. Weight must correspond to height for all posts. PST/PET is qualifying/eliminating in nature and does not carry marks. Relaxation in height/chest is permitted only on production of the prescribed competent-authority certificate.

Medical Examination

All candidates who qualify Paper-II undergo a Detailed Medical Examination (DME) by CAPF Medical Officers. A Review Medical Examination (RME) is conducted for candidates found unfit in DME, preferably the next day; the decision of the Review Medical Board is final. DME/RME is mandatory but qualifying in nature.

Document Verification

Document Verification is conducted by the CAPFs before final result declaration, preferably alongside the DME/RME stage. Candidates must bring two passport-size colour photographs, one original valid Photo ID proof, and originals plus copies of: Matriculation/Secondary Certificate, Educational Qualification Certificate, equivalence order/letter (if applicable), Caste/Category Certificate (if reserved category), Driving Licence (for Delhi Police male candidates), and Ex-Servicemen undertaking/certificates (if applicable).

  • General Intelligence and Reasoning: Analogies, similarities/differences, space visualization, problem solving, coding-decoding, number/figural series, syllogistic reasoning, Venn diagrams, critical thinking, etc.
  • General Knowledge and General Awareness: Current events, History, Culture, Geography, Economic Scene, General Polity, Indian Constitution, Scientific Research.
  • Quantitative Aptitude: Number systems, percentage, ratio, averages, interest, profit & loss, time & work, algebra, geometry, trigonometry, mensuration, data interpretation (graphs, histograms, pie charts).
  • English Comprehension: Error recognition, fill in the blanks, vocabulary, spellings, grammar, sentence structure, synonyms, antonyms, idioms, comprehension.

BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer Recruitment 2026 Selection Process

  • Selection is through a Written Test, followed by an Interview only for those candidates who qualify in the written test

How to Apply for BEL Sr. Asst. Engineer Recruitment 2026

  4. Place the filled application and documents in a sealed cover, superscribing on the cover: "Application for the post of Sr. Asst. Engineer, E-I Grade/NCS SBU".
  5. Send the sealed cover by Registered Post/Speed Post/Courier only to: Deputy General Manager (HR & Administration), Bharat Electronics Limited, Ghaziabad.
  6. Ensure the application reaches BEL on or before 16 October 2026.
Important: Applications delivered by hand will not be accepted. Only one application should be submitted per candidate; if multiple applications are received, only the latest valid (completed) one will be retained. Applications received after the last date will not be considered.

Documents Required

Tie-Breaking Rules

If two or more applicants obtain equal marks, preference will be given in the following order:

  6. Players who participated at the prescribed level but did not win a medal, in the same order of preference.

SBI SCO Recruitment 2026-27 Selection Process

For Marketing Executive (Advt No. 20) and Both IT Risk Posts (Advt No. 22)

  • Shortlisting, followed by Interview.

Common Selection Process (Both Notifications)

  • Shortlisting: A shortlisting committee constituted by the Bank decides the shortlisting parameters; merely fulfilling minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. The Bank's decision is final, with no correspondence entertained.
  • CTC Negotiation: Conducted with candidates in order of merit, one by one. If a selected candidate does not agree to the negotiated CTC, they are treated as a Voluntary Exit, and the next candidate in the merit list is called for negotiation.
  • Merit List: Prepared in descending order based on interview marks only. In case of a tie at the cut-off, candidates are ranked by age in descending order (older candidate ranked higher).
  • Final Selection: Top-most candidates in the merit list with whom CTC negotiation is successful are finally selected.

Shortlisting is provisional and without verification of original documents; candidature is subject to verification of all details/documents against originals at the time of interview. If a candidate called for interview/CTC negotiation is found not satisfying the eligibility criteria (age, educational qualification, experience, etc.), they will not be allowed to appear for interview, and no travelling expenses will be reimbursed.

  5. Once the application is completely filled, submit it and proceed to online fee payment (if applicable) via Debit Card/Credit Card/Internet Banking/UPI.
  6. On successful payment, an e-receipt and application form bearing the submission date will be generated - print and retain this for your records.
  7. Complete registration and fee payment before the closing date, 06.10.2026. The registration process is complete only when the fee is deposited on or before this date.

Candidates should have a valid Email ID and active mobile number, kept functional until declaration of results and issuance of call letters, since all communication (call letters, interview advice) will be sent only by email - no hard copy will be sent.

  • The Bank reserves the right to post/transfer engaged officers to any office of SBI in India, or depute them to any associate/subsidiary or other organization, depending on service requirements. Requests for a specific posting location will not be entertained.

  • Candidates against whom there are adverse reports regarding character, antecedents, or moral turpitude are not eligible to apply; if such reports are received after selection, the candidature/engagement will be rejected forthwith.
  • Mere fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria (qualification and experience) does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview.

As per Government of India guidelines, the upper age limit for Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) is relaxed by an additional 10 years, and for Ex-servicemen by an additional 5 years.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Salary

Position Pay Band (IBA 12th Bipartite Settlement) Approximate Starting Annual CTC
Deputy Manager (Scale JM-I) ₹48480 – 2000 – 62480 – 2340 – 67160 – 2680 – 85920 ₹18 lakh (approximately)
Manager (Scale MM-II) ₹64820 – 2340 – 67160 – 2680 – 93960 ₹20 lakh (approximately)

In addition to pay, selected candidates are eligible for allowances, perquisites, and benefits applicable to the grade as per the Bank's rules prevailing at the time of joining, including residential/leased accommodation (subject to availability) and loan schemes for housing, vehicle, and children's education.

Exim Bank Recruitment 2026 Application Fee

Category Application Fee / Intimation Charges (Non-refundable)
OBC ₹600/-
SC / ST / PwBD / Female candidates ₹100/- (Intimation charges)

Fees are non-refundable, including in cases where the applicant is later found ineligible for the post. Bank transaction charges for online payment must be borne by the candidate. The notification does not separately specify a fee amount for General/Unreserved male candidates.

Exim Bank Deputy Manager & Manager Selection Process

Selection comprises a Written Test followed by a Personal Interview.

Structure of Written Test

Name of Test Section No. of Questions Max. Marks Time
Professional Knowledge – Subjective Part I – Question 1 (Compulsory) 1 40 2 hours 30 minutes
Part II – Attempt any 6 out of 8 Questions 6 (of 8) 60
Total 100 2 hours 30 minutes

There is no sectional cut-off; the final list for interviews is drawn based on the candidate's overall performance in the written test. Final selection is based on combined performance in the Written Examination (out of 100, with 70% weightage) and the Interview (out of 100, with 30% weightage). A pre-recruitment training will be organised for candidates from reserved categories who opt for it through the online application form.

How to Apply for Exim Bank Recruitment 2026

Candidates can apply online only, from 15 September 2026 to 10 October 2026. No other mode of application will be accepted.

  1. Visit the Bank's Online Application page and click "APPLY ONLINE."
  2. Choose "Click here for New Registration" and enter Name, Contact details, and Email ID. A Provisional Registration Number and Password will be generated and also sent via email/SMS.
  3. Fill in the application form; use "SAVE AND NEXT" to save progress before final submission, since no changes are possible after clicking "COMPLETE REGISTRATION."
  4. Upload your Photograph, Signature, Left Thumb Impression, and Handwritten Declaration as per the prescribed specifications.
  5. Fill in remaining details, preview the application, and click "COMPLETE REGISTRATION" only after verifying all details.
  6. Proceed to the "Payment" tab and complete the online fee payment, then click "Submit."
  7. Take a printout of the e-Receipt and the completed online application form for future reference.

Note: Candidates can apply for only one post. If a candidate applies for more than one post, only the latest valid (completed) application/registration will be retained, and fees paid for other registrations will stand forfeited.

Documents and Scanned Images Required

Document Specification
Photograph 4.5cm × 3.5cm, colour, white/light background, 200×230 pixels, 20–50 KB, JPG/JPEG
Signature Black ink on white paper, not in capital letters, 140×60 pixels, 10–20 KB, JPG/JPEG
Left Thumb Impression Black or blue ink on white paper, 240×240 pixels at 200 DPI (3cm × 3cm), 20–50 KB, JPG/JPEG
Handwritten Declaration In English, black ink on white paper, 800×400 pixels at 200 DPI (10cm × 5cm), 50–100 KB, JPG/JPEG
Mark Sheets, Degree Certificates, Experience/Relieving Letter, Caste Certificate (if applicable) PDF format, 20–500 KB

Important Instructions

  • Candidates should be willing to serve anywhere in India; selected candidates may also be transferred to offices outside India with their consent.
  • OBC caste certificates must specifically contain the non-creamy layer clause and must be valid (issued within one year prior to) the last date of applying.
  • Deputy Managers must execute a personal bond of ₹3 lakhs to serve the Bank for a minimum of 5 years from the date of joining.
  • Candidates who have defaulted on loan repayment or appear in the CIBIL defaulter database are not eligible to join the Bank.
  • Selected candidates already in service must produce a proper relieving letter/discharge certificate in original at the time of joining.
  • Any legal proceedings related to this advertisement can be instituted only in Mumbai, with courts/tribunals in Mumbai having sole and exclusive jurisdiction.
  • The Bank reserves the right to cancel, restrict, curtail, or enlarge the recruitment process, including the number of vacancies, at any stage without notice.
  • Candidates whose writing speed is permanently affected may use a scribe at their own cost and arrangement, subject to the Bank's stipulated scribe guidelines, and will be eligible for compensatory time of 20 minutes per hour of examination if registered for it in advance.

Action against misconduct: Candidates found using unfair means, impersonation, misbehaviour in the examination/interview hall, disclosing or transmitting exam content, carrying mobile phones/electronic devices into the hall, or providing false information may be disqualified from the examination, debarred from future Bank examinations, or, if already employed, have their service terminated - in addition to being liable for criminal prosecution.

When Is the RRB ALP Exam in 2026?

The RRB ALP CBT-1 exam is tentatively scheduled from 03/11/2026 to 05/11/2026. How to Check RRB ALP Exam City and Download the E-Call Letter

  1. Open the official website of the RRB you applied to (the list is given under Important Links below).
  2. Find the link for CEN 01/2026 Assistant Loco Pilot exam city and date.
  3. Log in with your candidate credentials. Keep your Registration Number handy, as the CEN advises candidates to note it for later stages. The notice does not list the exact login fields.
  4. Check your exam city and date. SC/ST candidates who opted for free travel can download the Travel Authority here.
  5. About 4 days before your exam date, return to the same website and download the e-call letter.
  6. Print the e-call letter. RRBs do not send call letters by post.

Important Instructions for the RRB ALP Exam

  • Aadhaar biometric authentication: Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication will be done at the exam centre before entry to the exam hall.
  • Verify Aadhaar in advance: candidates who have not authenticated their identity through Aadhaar should do so by logging in at www.rrbapply.gov.in, so that entry to the centre is smooth.
  • Keep Aadhaar unlocked: even candidates who verified Aadhaar during the application should make sure it remains unlocked in the UIDAI system before the exam day.
  • Update Aadhaar details: the Aadhaar card should show the correct name, date of birth (as per the Class 10 certificate), latest photograph, address and father's name.
  • No change of centre, date or shift: the CEN does not allow any request to change the exam date, centre or shift. Candidates may have to travel to another city or state.
  • Banned items: mobile phones, watches, earphones, Bluetooth devices, calculators, books, papers, bags, wallets, water bottles, food items and similar articles are not allowed inside the centre. A cloak room may not be available, so avoid carrying valuables.
  • Avoid henna: applying henna on hands or feet can obstruct biometric capture.
  • Self-declaration: candidates must write the self-declaration paragraph, sign it and affix the left thumb impression on the e-call letter at the exam hall, in front of the invigilator. Writing it in advance or signing in capital letters leads to rejection.
  • Trust only official sources: refer only to the official RRB websites for updates. RRBs do not appoint agents or coaching centres, and selection is based on merit in the CBT stages.

Documents to Carry on the Exam Day

  • Printed e-call letter
  • Original Aadhaar card or a printout of e-verified Aadhaar, as asked in the notice
  • Original photo ID as instructed on the e-call letter (the CEN lists ID types such as Voter ID, Aadhaar, driving licence, PAN card and passport)
  • A recent colour passport-size photograph, not older than two months from the exam date
  • For SC/ST candidates travelling on the free travel facility: the original community certificate and an original photo ID during the journey, and a self-attested photocopy of the e-call letter and SC/ST certificate while booking the ticket

  • Candidates must have a B.Com. Degree from a course approved by UGC and AICTE, wherever applicable, with the degree recognized by the respective authorities.   • Candidates must have a Graduate Degree in any stream along with a Certificate in Shorthand with a speed of 80 words per minute in English.   • Candidates must have ITI in Electrical trade or a Diploma in Electrical Engineering, along with a valid Wireman Certificate.
Machinist
  • Candidates must have an ITI Certificate in Turner, Machinist, Grinder, or Miller trade, or a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Production Engineering, or Tool & Die Engineering.
Technician (Drilling)
  • Candidates must have an ITI Certificate in Mechanic (Earth Moving Machinery), Diesel Mechanic, Motor Mechanic, or Fitter trade, or a Diploma in Drilling or Mechanical Engineering. Candidates must also possess a valid HMV (Heavy Motor Vehicle) License.
Mechanic
  • Candidates must have an ITI Certificate in Diesel Mechanic, Motor Mechanic, or Fitter trade, or a Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Automobile Engineering, Production Engineering, or Manufacturing Engineering. Candidates must also possess a valid HMV (Heavy Motor Vehicle) License.
Junior Driver
  • Candidates must have passed 10th Class and possess both a valid LMV (Light Motor Vehicle) License and a valid HMV (Heavy Motor Vehicle) License.

  • Candidates must have a BCA, BCS, BCCA, B.Sc. in Computer Science/IT/Computer Applications, or Bachelor of Information System & Management (BISM) degree from a recognized university.   • Candidates must have a BA, B.Com, B.Sc., BBA, BBM, or BSW Degree from a recognized institution. How to Download the GPSC District Education Officer and District Primary Education Officer Provisional Answer Key 2026

  1. Visit the official GPSC website: gpsc.gujarat.gov.in.

How to Raise an Objection Against the GPSC Answer Key 2026

  1. Pay the objection fee of Rs. 100 for each question you wish to challenge.
  2. Submit your objection only after the fee payment is completed; the receipt generated after payment is treated as the final submission.
  3. Refer strictly to the question number and options as given in the Master Question Paper published with the provisional answer key.
  4. Make sure the answer you are suggesting matches the response you actually marked in your own answer sheet or response sheet.
  5. Upload a valid supporting document or reference along with your objection.
  6. Submit all objections before the deadline of 28 September 2026, 04:00 PM.

Important Instructions for Candidates

  • Objections can be submitted only through the Online Objection Submission System. Objections sent by post, email, or any other physical means will not be considered.
  • Objections must be raised with reference to the Master Question Paper only. Objections based on question numbers or options from a candidate's own booklet (if different from the Master Question Paper) will not be entertained.
  • If the answer suggested in an objection does not match the response given by the candidate in their own answer sheet, that objection will not be considered.
  • An objection without a supporting document or authentic reference will be rejected.
  • Objections generated solely using AI, GPT, or similar tools, without independent supporting evidence, will not be considered.
  • For calculation-based, mathematical, statistical, or reasoning questions, candidates must provide the relevant calculation, method, or logical basis along with the objection.
  • The Rs. 100 objection fee, once paid, is non-refundable regardless of whether the objection is accepted or rejected.

The Indian Statistical Service (ISS) Examination is conducted annually by the Union Public Service Commission to fill vacancies in the Indian Statistical Service, one of India's organised Group A Central Services. After the provisional answer key is released and the objection window closes, UPSC reviews all valid representations before publishing the Final Answer Key.

Once the objection period ends, UPSC's subject matter experts review all representations submitted by candidates. Valid objections where an answer is found to be incorrect based on credible references result in changes to the final answer key. The Final Answer Key is then published on the official website. The final marks are computed based on the final (not provisional) answer key, which forms the basis for merit list preparation and eventual selection to the Indian Statistical Service.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 - Download Link, Scorecard, and Marking Scheme

The Staff Selection Commission released the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026 on 17th June 2026, along with individual scorecards and response sheets for the Combined Graduate Level Examination 2025-26. Candidates who appeared in the Tier 2 exam, held on 18th and 19th January 2026, can now log in at ssc.gov.in using their Registration ID and password to download their final answer key, marks, and response sheet. The facility is available until 16th July 2026 (9:00 PM), after which the documents will no longer be accessible.

This release comes more than two months after SSC declared the Tier 2 final result on 8th April 2026, where 15,118 candidates were provisionally selected for various Group B and Group C posts. The final answer key now gives every candidate, selected or not, a way to verify exactly how their score was calculated.

Click Here: SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

What Is the SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section explains what the final answer key actually is and how it differs from the result already announced earlier this year. The final answer key is the Commission's conclusively reviewed set of correct answers for every question in the Tier 2 exam, finalized after evaluating all objections submitted against the provisional key.

Unlike the provisional answer key released on 30th January 2026, this final version cannot be challenged further. It is the key against which your actual Tier 2 marks were computed, and it is now being made available alongside your scorecard so you can independently verify your result. Since the final result and merit list were already published on 8th April 2026, this release functions primarily as a transparency and verification step rather than one that changes selection outcomes.

How to Download SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key 2026

This section walks you through the exact login process to access your final answer key, scorecard, and response sheet from the official SSC portal.

The download process requires your individual login credentials rather than a single public link, since the answer key and scorecard are personalized to each candidate's response sheet. Follow these steps:

  1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in.
  2. Look for the notification related to the Tier 2 scorecard and final answer key for CGL 2025-26.
  3. Click on the candidate login link provided in the notification.
  4. Enter your Registration ID and Password to log in.
  5. Your scorecard, final answer key, and response sheet will be displayed on the screen.
  6. Download and save the PDF files for future reference before the access window closes.

Since this is a login-gated system tied to individual candidate records, there is no generic public download link that works for all candidates; each person must sign in with their own registered credentials.

What Information Does the Scorecard Contain

The scorecard released alongside the final answer key gives a detailed, section-wise breakdown of your performance. It typically includes your section-wise raw marks, normalized marks (since the exam was conducted across multiple shifts), your total score, and your qualifying status. Reviewing this alongside the final answer key helps you understand exactly how your final score was derived.

SSC CGL Tier 2 Marking Scheme 2026

Knowing the exact marking scheme is essential to understanding how your scorecard was calculated using the final answer key. The Tier 2 exam followed different marking rules for Paper 1 and Paper 2.

Paper Correct Answer Wrong Answer
Paper 1 (Sections I, II & Computer Module I) +3 marks -1 mark
Paper 2 (Statistics) +2 marks -0.50 marks

Unattempted questions carry zero marks under both papers, so there is no penalty for skipping a question you were unsure about. Paper 2 was applicable only to candidates who applied for Junior Statistical Officer and Statistical Investigator Grade II posts.

Timeline: From Provisional Key to Final Answer Key

This section traces the complete sequence of events from the Tier 2 exam to the release of the final answer key, helping candidates understand how each stage led to the next.

  • The Tier 2 exam was conducted on 18th and 19th January 2026.
  • The provisional answer key was released on 30th January 2026, with an objection window open until 3rd February 2026 (8:00 PM).
  • SSC reviewed all valid objections submitted against the provisional key.
  • The Tier 2 final result and merit list were declared on 8th April 2026, with 15,118 candidates provisionally selected.
  • The sliding process for post allocation was conducted between 13th and 22nd April 2026 across regional offices.
  • The final answer key, individual scorecards, and response sheets were released on 17th June 2026, accessible until 16th July 2026.

Why Check Your SSC CGL Tier 2 Final Answer Key and Scorecard

Even though the final result has already been announced, reviewing your final answer key and scorecard remains useful for several reasons. It allows you to verify the accuracy of your marks against the officially finalized answers, understand your section-wise and overall performance through normalized scores, and maintain a personal record for future reference, since access to these documents is time-limited. Candidates who were not selected can also use this data to identify weaker sections and plan more effectively for future SSC exam attempts.

Total Score = (No. of Correct Answers × 2) − (No. of Wrong Answers × 0.25)

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do

  • Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

  • Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

  • Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

  • Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

  • Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

  • Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

  • Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

  • Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for

  • Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

  • Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

  • AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

  • High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

  • Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

  • Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit

  • Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

  • MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

  • Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting

  • Competitive, top-of-market compensation

  • You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

  • Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

  • Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

We give Entrepreneurs time back to focus on what they love doing - growing their business and being with customers. With a surging number of Entrepreneurs globally, we are innovating in a highly lucrative space.

Corporate Secretary: Automating the company incorporation, secretarial, filing, Nominee Director, mailroom and immigration processes via custom online robots and SleekSign. We are the market leaders in Singapore with ~5% market share of all new business incorporations

Accounting & Bookkeeping: Redefining what it means to do Accounting, Bookkeeping, Tax and Payroll thanks to our proprietary SleekBooks ledger, AI tools and exceptional customer service

FinTech payments: Overcoming a key challenge for Entrepreneurs by offering digital banking services to new businesses

Sleek launched in 2017 and now has around 17,500 customers across our offices in Singapore, Hong Kong, Australia and the UK. We have around 600 staff with an intact startup mindset. We have recently raised Series B financing off the back of >70% compound annual growth in Revenue over the last 5 years. Sleek has been recognised by The Financial Times, The Straits Times, Forbes and LinkedIn as one of the fastest growing companies in Asia. Backed by world-class investors, we are on track to be one of the few cash flow positive, tech-enabled unicorns based out of Asia Pacific.

Mission of the role

To ensure the accurate, timely, and compliant processing of payroll for multiple UK clients. The UK Payroll Executive will be responsible for managing payroll data, processing payroll transactions, supporting workplace pension auto-enrolment, responding to client queries, and ensuring all payroll activities are completed in line with UK labour laws, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and agreed client timelines.

The role requires strong attention to detail, client service, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple payrolls and deadlines efficiently while continuously looking for ways to improve workflows through technology, AI, and automation.

Key outcomes In the first 6â12 monthsOutcome 1: UK Payroll Knowledge & Process Proficiency

Develop a strong foundational understanding of UK payroll regulations and processes and confidently apply the appropriate rules when preparing and processing client payrolls.

Become fully familiar with Sleek's internal payroll platforms and processes, including HMRC submissions such as RTI, FPS and EPS, workplace pension submissions, and year-end reporting requirements including P60s and P11Ds by the third month.

Outcome 2: Accurate & Compliant Payroll Processing

Process assigned client payrolls accurately and within agreed timelines, ensuring all payroll data is complete and correctly validated before submission.

Ensure 100% compliance with agreed payroll and statutory deadlines, including payroll runs, pension auto-enrolment submissions, and applicable HMRC requirements.

Identify discrepancies or potential issues early, take ownership of resolving them, and maintain high standards of confidentiality and data accuracy.

Outcome 3: Client Service & Responsiveness

Maintain a high level of client satisfaction by providing prompt, accurate, and professional responses to payroll-related queries.

Consistently achieve a CSAT target of at least 97% month-on-month while ensuring that client queries and emails are responded to within the agreed communication SLA, with no non-reply tickets or emails left unresolved at the end of the working day.

Build trusted relationships with clients by providing clear updates, proactively following up on outstanding information, and handling difficult conversations positively when required.

Outcome 4: Team Collaboration & Process Improvement

Work effectively with the UK Payroll team and other internal departments to ensure smooth payroll operations and timely resolution of client or processing issues.

Contribute to improving payroll processes and operational efficiency by identifying opportunities to use AI, automation, payroll technology, and improved workflows to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase turnaround times.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 1â2 years of hands-on UK payroll processing experience.
  • Experience working in a bureau, outsourced payroll environment, or shared services centre is preferred.
  • Experience managing multiple client payroll accounts is an advantage.
  • Working knowledge of UK payroll processes, HMRC requirements, tax regulations, and workplace pension processes.
  • Experience with payroll software such as BrightPay, Xero Payroll, or similar is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and experience working with sensitive and confidential financial information.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet strict deadlines.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Comfortable working with data and payroll-related reporting and metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools, automation, and IT applications to improve daily workflows.

Must-have attributes

Ownership & Accountability: Takes full responsibility for assigned payrolls and client accounts, follows through on tasks without constant supervision, and proactively resolves issues or roadblocks.

Humility: Open to feedback, willing to learn, and comfortable acknowledging knowledge gaps and seeking support when required.

Structured Thinking: Able to organise multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and tasks in a clear and logical manner, while using sound judgement to prioritise competing requirements.

Data Driven & Attention to Detail: Comfortable working with numbers and payroll data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Able to identify discrepancies, missing information, or inconsistencies before they impact payroll processing or clients.

Can Have Tough Conversations in a Positive Way: Able to communicate clearly and professionally when dealing with sensitive payroll issues, missing information, delays, or difficult client situations while maintaining a constructive client relationship.

AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, automation, and technology to make payroll processes more efficient and effective.

We will be looking for candidates who have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.

Humility: There is so much we don't know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self-awareness and emotional intelligence.

Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you're more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.

Attention to detail: You'll be managing multiple client payrolls, deadlines, queries, and workstreams. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing, inconsistent, or likely to cause an issue.

Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn't their first language. For you to excel, you'll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process

The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

TA Screen / One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess spoken and written communication, relevant UK payroll experience, motivation, and initial background.

Technical Round: A 30-minute interview and practical assessment with the Hiring Team to assess UK payroll knowledge, payroll processing experience, attention to detail, ability to work with payroll data, and understanding of UK payroll processes and deadlines.

Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioural values, including ownership, humility, structured thinking, communication, and ability to handle challenging situations.

Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct one professional reference check with your recent direct manager or supervisor. To keep the process moving smoothly, this step may be initiated during the final interview stages.

Requirement for background screening

Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history

We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation.

By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Personal growth: Youâll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so youâll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. Role Snapshot

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

    Â 

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

    Â 

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

    Â 

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The Problem

36 million businesses in America need insuranceâit's not optional. 77% are underinsured. 40% have no coverage at all. The distribution system failed them: too slow, too opaque, too confusing.

Over 90% of commercial insurance is still human-led. We're building the inverse: 90%+ AI-led, pushing toward the higher 90s. Not by patching legacy workflowsâby building AI that makes humans more effective, improves the customer experience, and eliminates friction at every step.

We're adding ~1,000 customers per month. We've grown 100x since last year. We're looking to do even more this yearâand that's why we're hiring.

You'll build the team and the systems the rest of engineering depends on. When they compound, everyone gets faster.

The Thesis

Harper runs 200+ services across Railway and AWS. We orchestrate N parallel agentic workloads. Our AI systems make thousands of decisions a day, and every decision needs to be traceable, evaluated, and cheaper to run tomorrow than it is today. The infrastructure underneath all of that is the difference between a company that scales and one that stalls.

Great platform engineering here isn't invisibleâit's the reason product ships fast. When observability catches a silent failure before a customer does. When a pooling layer makes connection exhaustion a non-issue. When developer velocity doubles because someone built the tool nobody knew they needed. That leverage compounds across every other engineer on the team.

The Role

This role is open both to an experienced EM and to someone on the path to becoming an EM who doesn't yet have significant management experienceâwe're happy to bring that person on and support the transition.

This is a team that still needs to be built. We have 2 people in it today, and we believe this area needs significant investment at Harper. The role owns three things: infrastructure (cloud, third-party vendors, and everything surrounding it), developer productivity (making sure we're genuinely an AI-first shop, with the right AI tooling and harnesses in place for every other engineering team to be successful), and SRE and production support (production discipline is top of mind as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phaseâwe need someone who has run an SRE function before). Each of these three areas can grow into a larger team of its own over time.

The team is 2 people today, growing to five to six over the next three months. Because the team is small, whoever takes this roleâEM or TLMâwill need to be hands-on at the start, working directly with the team and doing the work themselves.

What You'll Do

  • Own SRE and production support â bring production discipline as we head into a high-growth, high-scale phase

Nice to Have

  • Experience building a team from a very small base

  • Prior startup experienceâespecially at a company scaling through hypergrowth

Compensation & Logistics

The Process
